split.find: 1/8|1\s?G(?:RAM)?\s+JOINT\b|5\s+PACKS|(?<=, |D )VAPE\b|[A-Z][\w ]{2,30}(?=: An? [\w ,-]{0,60}live rosin vape)|[A-Z][A-Z']*(?: [A-Z][A-Z']*)*? FLOWER X [A-Z][A-Z' ]+? ROSIN\b

skip.why: 'VAPE' in a strain's AVAILABLE IN line names no device or size (Mafia Funeral); the site's sized vapes are the Rosin Vape page's 1G AIOs

learned: 2026-10-08, agent pass: electraleaf.com is a WooCommerce site whose Store API lists 90 products, each a strain page (type simple, price 0, not purchasable) with an 'AVAILABLE IN ...' format line; 7 are filed under 'electraleaf MA'. The format pages (/portfolio/5-pack-joints/, /portfolio/rosin-vapes/, /portfolio/1g-infused-joints/) state the sizes. 173 New York entries.
notes: Read as kind json from the Store API (not wc_store_api) because the wc_store_api reader cuts the description at 2000 characters, and this site's descriptions are WPBakery/Uncode shortcode markup: the Rosin Vape strain list and the infused-joint blend list sit past that cut. One page of 100 holds all 90; pages 2-5 come back [] and add nothing, so growth past 100 is read without a change.

Each strain page's heading says the formats: 'AVAILABLE IN 1/8', '1/8 and 1G JOINT', '1/8 ,1G JOINT, 5 PACKS AND VAPE', '1/8 5 PACKS 1GRAM JOINT'. `split` makes one item per format word, and the category rules read the piece: 1/8 = 3.5g flower, 1G/1GRAM JOINT = 1g pre-roll, 5 PACKS = 2.5g pre-roll pack (the 5-pack page: 'five half-gram pre-rolls'). A page with only '1/8' is not split and is read by its 'AVAILABLE IN 1/8[' heading.

'VAPE' in a strain's format line (Mafia Funeral; Godzilla Glue, an MA page) names no device or size and is skipped. The sized vapes are the 'Rosin Vape' page: '1G AIO DEVICE', live rosin, strains listed as 'Zangria: A smooth indica live rosin vape ...' (Zangria, Jelly Rancher, Blueberry Muffin, Papaya); split reads each name before ': A ... live rosin vape'.

'INFUSED JOINTS' is the Rosin Roll (Electraleaf flower x Olio rosin, PICC hash-hole), '1G JOINTS', blends written 'GELONADE FLOWER X GAS TANKER ROSIN'; the strain is 'flower X rosin' as stores write their infused pre-rolls ('Blue Dream x Zangria Rosin Infused Preroll'). The heading says '5 BLENDS' but four are listed. Stores sell other blends (Cannolis x Blueberry Muffin, Blue Dream x Zangria, Super Lemon Diesel x Papaya), so the site's blend list lags; those stay store-only. 'Rosin Roll' is not used as a line: stores never use it and it describes the format (rosin-infused joint).

Products in category 'electraleaf MA' (Stardawg, Zerealz, Blue Zuzhi, Purple Chemdawg, Peanut Butter Sundae, Womo, Godzilla Glue) are skipped as Massachusetts-only. NY stores do sell Godzilla Glue (3.5g at 3 stores, a 1g pre-roll at one), so it is kept from the stores' consensus.

Names: title_case fixes the all-caps and lower-case titles (ALLEY OOP, ZOAP, ZERBERT, COTTON CANDY, laughing buddha). Title rules fix four more: 'Dead Head Og' (Dead Head OG), 'Rainbow belts' (Rainbow Belts), 'D lish' (D-Lish, as the page writes it), 'Blooodclaat' (Bloodclaat, as the page writes it).

Not read: Crispy's (/crispys/), the brand's 100mg crispy-rice edible bars (Cookies and Cream, Bedrock Bar, Birthday Cake, Hangry Bar), are a page of prose outside the Store API, and no store lists them under ElectraLeaf.
